text.traceableprint.title: Traceable Print Settings
text.traceableprint.option.enableMod.@To: Master switch. All Mobs: every mob leaves footprints (still filtered by the block and entity lists). Player Only: only players leave footprints. Disabled: the mod does nothing.
Show an action-bar warning to a player when someone follows their footprints all the way to the end of the trail.
text.traceableprint.option.printsForInvi: Whether entities under invisibility (effect or invisible flag) still leave footprints. Sneaking always suppresses prints regardless of this setting.
text.traceableprint.option.highlightTick: How long a footprint chain glows through walls after it is traced.
text.traceableprint.option.entityListInv: Off: the entity list is a blacklist - listed mobs leave no footprints. On: it becomes a whitelist - only listed mobs leave footprints.
text.traceableprint.option.entityList.@T: Entity IDs as namespace:path, or #namespace:tag for a whole tag. Acts as a blacklist or a whitelist depending on 'Invert Entity List'.
text.traceableprint.option.applyBlocks.@: Blocks that always permit footprints regardless of the hardness gate: namespace:path, or #namespace:tag for a tag.
text.traceableprint.option.lifetime.@Too: How long a footprint lingers before it fades away.
text.traceableprint.option.spawnInterval: Ticks between movement checks that may drop a new footprint.
text.traceableprint.option.minDistance.@: Minimum distance, in blocks, between two consecutive footprints. Closer steps are skipped.
Footprints only appear where the block's hardness is below this value. Blocks in 'Always-Allow Blocks' bypass this check.
text.traceableprint.option.textureSize.@: Base size of a footprint in blocks (square side length). The per-mob size list multiplies on top of this.
text.traceableprint.option.yOffset.@Tool: Extra upward lift, in hundredths of a block, to keep the footprint from clipping into the ground.
text.traceableprint.per_mob.header: Each entry is 'modid:mobid,value'. Mobs match by exact 'namespace:path' only (tags are not supported). Leave a list empty to fall back to the mod's built-in default.
text.traceableprint.option.sideOffsetLis: Entries 'modid:mobid,float' override the left/right offset for specific mobs.
text.traceableprint.option.forwardOffset: Entries 'modid:mobid,float' override the front/back offset for specific mobs.
text.traceableprint.option.sizeList.@Too: Entries 'modid:mobid,float' scale the footprint for specific mobs; multiple matches multiply together.
text.traceableprint.option.blockHeightLi: Entries 'blockid,float' or '#tagid,float' lift footprints by an extra amount on blocks such as snow layers, soul sand or mud.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.format: Format: 'modid:mobid,textureName1,textureName2,...' - the text before the first comma is the entity's registry name; everything after it is a pool of candidate texture names, and one is picked at random each time a footprint spawns.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.path: A bare name (no colon) resolves to traceableprint:textures/entity/<name>.png. Write a full 'namespace:path' to load art from another mod's or your own resource-pack namespace. The '.png' suffix is optional and matching is case-insensitive.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.match: Only exact 'namespace:path' matches apply here; tags (#namespace:tag) are not supported. If nothing matches, the default footprint.png is used.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.server: Important - which texture is chosen is decided by the SERVER's copy of this list. In multiplayer, if the server's config differs from yours, the server wins and your local list does not take part in the selection at all.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.single: Your client keeps only one veto: when a synced texture is missing from your loaded resource packs, that footprint falls back to the default footprint.png instead of erroring. In singleplayer the integrated server reads the very same file, so there is no difference.
